cohort: Pregnant women receiving methadone for opioid dependence
finding: A multiple daily dose methadone regimen in pregnancy was associated with lower rates of Neonatal Abstinence Syndrome (NAS) treatment and high rates of maternal recovery from opioid dependence.
mod_finding: This study found no association between a multiple daily dose methadone regimen during pregnancy and the need for treatment of Neonatal Abstinence Syndrome.
gest_age: Cohort outcomes in terms of gestational age... equaled or approximated US population norms
birth_weight: Cohort outcomes in terms of ... birth weight ... equaled or approximated US population norms
